title: Tree Traversal Quiz
description: A quick check to review preorder, inorder, and postorder traversal.

questions.questionText: Which traversal visits the root first?
questions.explanation: Preorder traversal visits Root, then Left, then Right.

questions.questionText: For a tree with root A, left child B, and right child C, what is the preorder output?
questions.codeSnippet:
Tree:
    A
   / \
  B   C

Preorder = Root, Left, Right
questions.explanation: Preorder visits the root first, then the left subtree, then the right subtree.
